About

Cookies and other data tracking technologies are text files or digital identifiers containing small amounts of information which are downloaded to your browsing device (such as a computer or smartphone) when you visit a website. These technologies can be recognized by the website that downloaded them, or by other websites that use the same tracking methods. First-party cookies and other data tracking technologies belong to Lifted, or are placed on your device by Lifted. Third-party cookies and other data tracking technologies are those that another party places on your browsing device through our Site.


Cookies and other data tracking technologies do lots of different jobs, like helping us understand how the Site is being used, letting you navigate between pages efficiently, remembering your preferences, and generally improving your browsing experience. They can also help ensure marketing you see online is more relevant to you and your interests.
